NetAgentBench.candidate_universe_rule: Generate the pinned FRR BGP and OSPF task descriptors using the repository generators; inspect task definitions only, not benchmark/model result reports.

Cornetto.candidate_universe_rule: Inspect all public scenario directories using file presence, topology, specifications, and static initial/final configuration text only. Do not use damage metrics, model outputs, published repair scores, or scenario outcome logs for compatibility decisions.

NetConfArena.candidate_universe_rule: Inspect all 96 upstream task templates and their startup configs, ground-truth command sets, topology, goals, and test definitions. Do not inspect agent/model result files for mapping decisions.

proofcarry_frozen_domain.forward_requirement: all protected prefixes remain fully visible at every nonterminal checkpoint
proofcarry_frozen_domain.terminal_requirement: exact target owners with full route visibility
proofcarry_frozen_domain.recovery_requirement: after every modeled cut, a fixed contingency plan restores exact baseline owners while preserving route visibility
proofcarry_frozen_domain.control_plane_scope: pre-existing stable BGP or OSPF topology; the transaction itself may not create or repair neighbor sessions, areas, interfaces, route policy, redistribution, MPLS, overlays, ACLs, or other unsupported objects

compatibility_rules_in_order.requirement: The external task is single-protocol BGP or single-protocol OSPF for the mapped objective; mixed-protocol objectives are incompatible.

The public external artifacts provide an explicit baseline configuration/state and an explicit target/ground-truth configuration or invertible change specification. Missing baseline or missing target is incompatible; baseline or target may not be inferred from benchmark outcome scores.

After removing configuration-mode/context syntax only, every semantically required change for the mapped objective is an exact-prefix route-advertisement add/remove. If success also requires neighbor/session setup, area/interface activation, path attributes, filtering, aggregation, redistribution, static routing, ACL/firewall, MPLS, tunnels, or other configuration objects, the task is incompatible.

Every protected exact prefix has at least one advertiser/owner in both baseline and target states, matching the frozen method schema. Creation from zero owners or deletion to zero owners is incompatible.
At least one protected prefix changes owner set between baseline and target. Pure adjacency establishment, path selection tuning, policy changes, or no-op ownership are incompatible.

A deterministic forward plan and a single fixed contingency plan can be derived solely from the external baseline/target owner delta: additions before removals, prefixes and devices sorted lexicographically; contingency is the exact inverse back to baseline, also additions before removals. No hand-authored per-case repair is allowed.

The external task supplies route/reachability/specification evidence that can independently check the mapped protected prefixes or final routing objective. Tasks whose oracle checks only syntax, adjacency, or unrelated behavior are incompatible.

Required configs/topology/specifications are locally readable and can be deterministically reduced to the ProofCarry semantic evidence interface without proprietary credentials or unavailable hidden artifacts.

deterministic_plan_adapter.forward_phase_1: for each target owner absent from baseline, add route advertisement
deterministic_plan_adapter.forward_phase_2: for each baseline owner absent from target, remove route advertisement
deterministic_plan_adapter.contingency_phase_1: for each baseline owner absent from target, add route advertisement
deterministic_plan_adapter.contingency_phase_2: for each target owner absent from baseline, remove route advertisement
deterministic_plan_adapter.dependency_rule: a remove for a prefix depends on all forward additions for that prefix; a contingency remove depends on all contingency additions for that prefix
deterministic_plan_adapter.authorization_rule: allow exactly the changed devices, route_advertisement, add/remove, and the mapped protected prefixes

prohibited_for_compatibility_decision: Cornetto damage metrics and forwarding-difference outcome magnitudes
any ProofCarry result on the candidate external task
outcome_blindness.prelock_structural_exposure_note: During source reconnaissance, one Cornetto example scenario_summary was opened to understand public artifact structure. Compatibility classification is not permitted to read scenario_summary or any damage/result fields, and no mapping decision is based on those fields.

claim_rule: If either the >=30 compatible-instance gate or >=2 independent-template gate fails, D7 external-transfer evidence is BLOCKED and C4 remains prohibited. The rules may not be relaxed after seeing the compatibility count or outcomes.
